question: SENSEX is an index of Bombay Stock Exchange's top _______ companies.
solution:
The correct answer is __**30 companies**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SENSEX** is an index that represents the top **30 companies** listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).
 
• It is one of the oldest stock market indices in India, introduced in 1986.
 
• The index is a benchmark indicator of the performance of the Indian stock market and reflects the overall market sentiment.
 
• The companies included in the SENSEX are chosen based on their market capitalization, liquidity, and industry representation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) is one of the oldest stock exchanges in Asia, established in 1875.
 
• The SENSEX is also known as the BSE 30 and is widely used by investors and financial professionals to gauge the health of the Indian economy.
 
• It covers various sectors such as finance, IT, consumer goods, energy, and healthcare, providing a comprehensive snapshot of the market.
 
• The SENSEX is calculated using the free-float market capitalization method, which considers the number of shares available for trading in the market.
